mantra.line: The board reads in ten seconds because it is built from data, not prose. The next board reads the last board plus the diff, not 126 KB of files.
One main effort: every status question answers itself on a page, in the same register, from the same term register. Everything else on this BOLO supports it.
The pages shipped in one evening on your word and got rebuilt the next morning. Names are provisional until you say them; the defaults run.

frago.mission: Deliver every [[sitrep|sit rep]] and every BOLO status as a rendered page in the ruled register, **in order to** put the whole operation in front of you in ten seconds without a scroll, and to stop the board costing a session's worth of reading to build.
frago.order: Nothing owed on the name. **READYROOM and MINT when you want them.**
frago.default: Silence: READYROOM for the sit rep program and MINT for the loop run as defaults. The theme is dark only; the light face is E-INK, provisional. The consult's picks live on DOPE SHEET 47.

paragraphs.name: Situation
paragraphs.plain: Where BOLO 38 stands: what was asked on 9/6, what you ruled on 9/10, and what shipped.

items.t: **The sit rep becomes a home window** — "the first thing that pops up when you open a save file — everything you need to see, that front page type shit." Blocks 0–VII as a dashboard; the proword loop (BOLO 37) as one panel; the CK3 information architecture (R1–R19) as the design source.

**The page becomes the board.** "Whenever I call for the sit rep, give it back to me in this format." One panel per block, jumped to by key; the explainer register on every panel; the CK3 tooltip rules at depth 3.
**The colorway** — the creator-cases explainer palette (slate · white · orange) for every internal board and tool page. The rose stays with [[darkroom|DARKROOM]] and public-facing work.
**[[dope-sheet|DOPE SHEET]] is the BOLO page (provisional), [[frago|FRAGO]] is the update onto it (ruled).** Your read of doctrine: "FRAGO is just the update after we've made the BOLO status page."
**[[soi|SOI]] is the tongue's book** — its own dashboard, the Marine SOI format. And 9/11: **"glossary" is retired as a word.** Every button and key says SOI.

**Theme: DARK only.** The toggle and the T key are gone. The light face, when a viewer forces it, is **E-INK**: Kindle-gray paper, never white (provisional tokens). And **"the house tongue" is retired** — "the lexicon" stands, provisional.
**SITREP** — v0 through v0.4 on 9/10 evening, v0.5 on 9/10 night (built the new way: last board + cache note + diff). Standing URL, republished every sit rep.

**DOPE SHEET 45** — the first BOLO page: the five-paragraph order, [[speed|SPEED]] · [[focus|FOCUS]] · [[boldness|BOLDNESS]] on the masthead, the FRAGO strip on top. Retitled and rebuilt 9/11 with the hold.

**SOI** — built 9/10 late, published 9/11: search, A to Z, by section, edition and authentication, the codebook parsed live from SOP §8. Both pages' buttons now point at it; the in-page views are gone.
**DOPE SHEET 38 and DOPE SHEET 42** — this page and the register's, both first builds 9/11.

paragraphs.name: Mission
paragraphs.plain: A mission is a task plus the reason for it. The reason outlasts the task.

strand.last: The chat board took 21 calls and 178 KB of reading to build. That was the reason.
strand.plan: Data in, page out; the same core under every page.
strand.you: You gave the picture (the save-load screen) and the register (the explainer).
strand.next: The end state is one name away on each of three fronts.

paragraphs.intent: in order to put the whole operation in front of you in ten seconds, and to cut what a board costs to build.

endstate: Every sit rep lands on one standing URL; the chat carries the link and the leverage line.
Every BOLO has an DOPE SHEET page on demand; FRAGOs fold deltas onto it.
The tongue has one book, the SOI, and nothing on any page says glossary.

phases.t: **Retitle for the DOPE SHEET/FRAGO split** — masthead DOPE SHEET · BOLO; page title DOPE SHEET N; the 45 board versioned v0.3 · DOPE SHEET.
**Rebuild and republish DOPE SHEET 45** with the hold and the five missing files folded in.
**Sit rep deltas** — folded on the 9/10 night board (v0.5); the SOI re-point republished as v0.6.
**Publish the SOI; re-point both templates** — the button is an outbound SOI link, the in-page views and the G-page are gone, the rail panel says SOI. SOP §0 patched.
**Names** — the page's name (DOPE SHEET struck; bench: DOPE rec) · READYROOM · MINT. Defaults run if silent.
**Refactor** — three templates share ~300 lines of CSS and the tooltip engine by copy; extract house.css and house.js when the next page is added. Not urgent.

**The dashboard consult** — delivered 9/11 in chat: a budget bar, build-side diffs, cached static panels, Agent View status words, approval keys on Block V, local token parsing, a git-diff changelog, a reset countdown. Don't copy: agent fleets, live servers, enterprise approval machinery. A FRAGO 38 folds in what you take.

coord: Three pipelines, one core: _tools/sitrep · _tools/bolostatus · _tools/soi. Each is data + template + build.py; every double-bracket key must exist in the shared register or the build fails on purpose.
The register (_tools/sitrep/glossary.json) is shared; re-read before writing when two sessions run.
Every ruled word goes into SOP and the register in the same turn (standing order 9/10).
Long heredocs die in Git Bash; scripts go to the scratchpad.
running: The dashboard-norms consult (one background agent, web only).
Nothing else. The pages build in seconds.

entries.t: BOLO 38 spoken with 37: the sit rep as the CK3 save-load screen.

Steps 1–4 walked: OPORD retitle · OPORD 45 rebuilt · SOI published · both templates re-pointed · OPORD 38 and 42 built. Consult launched.
"I do not like the word OPORD… something much cooler." Struck; bench ordered from the Corps, then military and games. Masthead reads STATUS until ruled.
"I like dope… get me the dope sheet." DOPE SHEET ruled. Then: the house tongue is not SOP; only one theme, dark; the light face should be Kindle-gray e-ink, not white. How copy.
Mastheads say DOPE SHEET; "the lexicon" replaces the house tongue; theme toggle removed from all three templates; E-INK light face written, provisional; everything rebuilt and republished.
